long_biography.plain_text:
Steam transformed Valve from a successful game studio into a direct digital platform connecting developers with players. Gabe Newell created the company with fellow Microsoft veteran Mike Harrington after spending 13 years at Microsoft, where he ran programme management for the first two Windows releases. Half-Life established the young business and later supplied the leverage Newell used to accelerate Steam.

Valve remained private while Steam expanded across third-party games and hardware, leaving Newell with direct control of the company he founded. Beyond gaming, he co-founded Starfish Neuroscience, which develops minimally invasive interfaces with the brain and body. Its flat, self-directed team is pursuing technologies designed to move from laboratory concepts towards practical clinical use.
